subject.title: feat(memorySearch): Support multimodal embedding with gemini-embedding-2-preview

question: Should OpenClaw expand multimodal memory beyond the shipped opt-in image/audio `extraPaths` subset into PDF/video files and remembered inbound attachments, and what consent, retention, deletion, provider-upload, and reindex contract should gate that expansion?
rationale: The remaining work is technically plausible but changes how raw user media can be uploaded to remote providers and persisted in searchable memory, so automation should not choose the product/security boundary.

options.title: Design gated media memory first
options.body: Define supported modalities, opt-in consent, retained-media storage/deletion behavior, provider limits, and reindex semantics before accepting implementation work.

options.title: Limit core to shipped subset
options.body: Keep OpenClaw core at image/audio files under `memorySearch.extraPaths` and route broader attachment/PDF/video work to a future plugin/API design.

options.title: Expand extraPaths only
options.body: Allow a narrower follow-up for PDF/video files under `extraPaths` while explicitly excluding chat-attachment retention for now.

recommendation.title: Design gated media memory first
recommendation.body: Define supported modalities, opt-in consent, retained-media storage/deletion behavior, provider limits, and reindex semantics before accepting implementation work.

likelyOwner.reason: gumadeiras introduced the shipped multimodal memory subset and is closest to the config/docs/runtime boundary the remaining decision would extend.
